definition: A situation where two opposing [players](/term/player) have discrete positive and negative outcomes and each attempts to [bait](/term/bait) the other into making a mistake. Mindgames primarily focus on prediction and guesswork rather than reaction-based execution. A common example of a mindgame involves a specific [engine interaction](/term/engine-interaction) between two abilities that counter each other—e.g. Sion’s Q versus Fiora’s W—where each player wants to use their ability to negate the other’s.
